devicesHelp: Add a TV with "+", enter name and IP address (a fixed IP is recommended) and save. Then pair it once: switch the TV on, click "Start pairing", enter the code shown on the TV and click "Confirm code". No developer options or ADB are required.
Name: Name
enableImeTooltip: Needed for the state currentApp and for sending text. Disable it if the TV keeps showing 'Use keyboard on mobile device'.
appsHelp: Each entry creates a button <device>.apps.<name> for every TV. Use a deep link (e.g. https://www.netflix.com/title) or the package name (e.g. org.xbmc.kodi). Any app can also be started via the state launchApp.
clientNameHelp: Shown on the TV during pairing
reconnectMaxHelp: If a TV is unreachable (e.g. unplugged), the retry interval doubles from 2 s up to this value.
pairingHint: Pairing is only needed once per TV (again after a factory reset). The instance must be running; the code is valid for about one minute.
